card.name: The word antibody and its endings
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word antibody or antibodies (IES, odies, ody) or the word antibody itself. It appears in drug-label headings, immunogenicity text and antibody-related warnings.

modes.label: Ending of antibodies
modes.description: The final piece of a split-up antibody or antibodies, often after Anti- or Antib.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF ANTI-METRELEPTIN ANTIBOD<<IES>> WITH NEUTRALIZING ACTIVITY

modes.label: Whole word antibody
modes.description: The full word antibody after a modifier such as monoclonal or blocking.
